admin.summary: Complete module-by-module guide to configure and run PesoWise for your organization.

admin-module-0-login.title: Module 0: Login and Admin Scope
paragraphs: Login to PesoWise and confirm you are in the admin account for the correct organization.
Admin scope includes: users, categories, form templates, approval governance, balances, reports, notifications, and organization settings.
Before any action, verify organization context in the top bar so changes are applied to the intended org.

admin-module-1-user-management.title: Module 1: User Management (Create, Update, Assign)
paragraphs: Open User Management from Admin menu.
Create single users with correct role (admin, manager, cashier, employee) and complete profile details.
For large onboarding, use Bulk Users Upload CSV and first run Dry-Run to validate data before final upload.
Check organization capacity in the uploader and ensure seat limits are available before import.
After creation, verify reporting assignments (employee to manager, cashier to location/manager).
If a user should no longer operate, deactivate or remove access to avoid accidental approvals.

admin-module-1-auto-email.title: Module 1a: Auto-Generated User Emails
paragraphs: When auto-email is enabled for your organization, new users may receive system-generated email addresses.
Use this for employees who do not have corporate email; they can still log in with employee ID where enabled.
Communicate login credentials securely after user creation.

admin-module-1-hierarchy-roles.title: Module 1b: Hierarchy Roles (Team Leader and Executive)
paragraphs: With approval hierarchy enabled, assign team leader and executive roles in User Management when those tiers are turned on for your org.
Team leaders and executives verify and may reject expenses in their queue; they cannot give final approval.
Assign each user to a team in Settings so routing sends expenses to the correct reviewer.
Use custom role labels in Settings if your organization uses different titles (for example Supervisor instead of Team Leader).

admin-module-2-category-management.title: Module 2: Category Management
paragraphs: Open Category Management to add, edit, activate, or archive categories.
Keep naming consistent (for example Fuel, Lodging, Client Travel) so reporting remains clean.
Avoid duplicate or near-duplicate category names; duplicates split analytics and create confusion for employees.
When policy changes, update categories and communicate expected usage to managers and employees.

admin-module-3-form-templates.title: Module 3: Expense Form Templates and Field Rules
paragraphs: Go to Settings and configure base fields and custom form field templates.
Set each field's visibility and required status based on your policy (submit, review, detail stages).
Use custom fields to capture business-specific metadata like project code, vehicle number, vendor, route, or approval note.
Validate template behavior by creating a test expense after changes.

admin-module-3-conditional-dropdowns.title: Module 3a: Conditional Dropdown Fields
paragraphs: When tiered dropdowns are enabled (Master Admin), edit a dropdown template in Settings.
Expand each option to add sub-fields shown only when that option is selected.
Test each branch with a sample expense so employees see the correct fields on submit.

admin-module-3-nested-dropdowns.title: Module 3b: Nested Conditional Dropdowns
paragraphs: Nested dropdowns let child options have their own sub-fields (multi-level select chains).
Configure parent option first, then add child dropdown options and fields under each child.
Keep chains shallow where possible so employees are not overwhelmed on mobile.

admin-module-4-settings.title: Module 4: Settings Page (Organization Controls)
paragraphs: Use Settings to manage organization-level controls such as approval thresholds and attachment rules.
Maintain location and operational settings required by cashier and manager assignment logic.
Review backup and restore options periodically and ensure export processes are tested.
Any settings update should be followed by a quick workflow test to confirm expected behavior.

admin-module-4-hierarchy-teams.title: Module 4a: Teams (org structure)
paragraphs: Open Settings and use Team Management to create teams and assign employee members.
Assign team leaders, executives, and managers on each team so leaders can view their teams on My Teams.
Teams work independently of multi-tier approval — enable Approval hierarchy separately if you need TL/executive review steps.
Confirm Master Admin has enabled Teams (org structure) for your organization.

admin-module-5-approval-review.title: Module 5: Review and Approve Expenses
paragraphs: Open Expense Review and process pending and escalated requests in queue order.
For each expense: verify title, category, location, amount, receipt readability, and workflow history or comments.
Approve policy-compliant claims; reject non-compliant or incomplete claims with clear corrective guidance.
For rejected entries, use precise comments so users can resubmit successfully in one attempt.

admin-module-5-hierarchy-review.title: Module 5a: Multi-Tier Hierarchy Review
paragraphs: With hierarchy enabled, expenses may arrive after team leader and/or executive verification.
Admin still gives final approval on escalated or high-value items per your threshold rules.
Monitor queues for items stuck at an intermediate tier and reassign teams if reviewers are unavailable.

admin-module-6-approval-governance.title: Module 6: Approval Governance and Threshold Rules
paragraphs: Ensure manager threshold logic is correctly configured so high-value claims route to admin.
Regularly review threshold values against finance policy and risk levels.
When threshold policy changes, update Settings and notify managers to avoid inconsistent decisions.

admin-module-corrections.title: Module 6a: Expense Corrections
paragraphs: When corrections are enabled, admins may edit another user's submitted expense and mark it as edited.
Use corrections for clear data entry mistakes; add a note in comments for audit.
After correction, the expense continues in the approval workflow from its current status.

admin-module-7-balances.title: Module 7: Balances and Transfers
paragraphs: Open Balances to fund users and cashiers and maintain cash flow continuity.
Use notes on manual balance edits for audit traceability.
Cross-check transfer history and returned amounts to prevent reconciliation mismatch.
Investigate large or frequent manual adjustments and resolve root causes.

admin-module-8-reports.title: Module 8: Reports and Analytics
paragraphs: Use Reports to analyze spending by category, employee, manager, location, and date range.
Export CSV or PDF outputs for finance, audit, and management reviews.
Track recurring anomalies (sudden spikes, repeated rejections, unusual category distributions).
Use insights to refine category definitions, field templates, and approval policy.

admin-module-9-notifications.title: Module 9: Notifications and Operational Monitoring
paragraphs: Monitor notifications continuously for new submissions, escalations, approvals, rejections, and return-related actions.
Prioritize old pending items first to reduce aging queues.
Use notification trends to identify bottlenecks in specific teams or users.

admin-module-10-admin-own-expense.title: Module 10: Admin Self Expense Flow
paragraphs: Admin can also submit own expenses from My Expenses, then Add Expense.
Fill form with complete details and upload receipt for transparency.
Track status and history exactly like any other user-submitted expense.

admin-module-11-daily-checklist.title: Module 11: Daily Admin Checklist
paragraphs: 1) Clear pending approvals and escalations.
2) Validate user, role, and team changes requested that day.
3) Review balance adjustments and transfer anomalies.
4) Spot-check reports for policy drift and unusual trends.
5) Ensure notification backlog is near zero before day close.

admin-pwa-install.title: Install PesoWise as an App (PWA)
paragraphs: On supported browsers, use the install banner or browser menu to add PesoWise to your home screen.
Installed apps open in full screen with your organization branding on tenant subdomains.
Use the installed app for faster access to approvals and expense entry in the field.

cashier.summary: Monitor, manage, and settle expenses across employees and managers.

cashier-getting-started.title: Step 1: Login to PesoWise
paragraphs: Open PesoWise and enter your login credentials.
You will land directly on the dashboard after successful login.

cashier-dashboard-overview.title: Part 1: Dashboard Overview
paragraphs: From the dashboard, you can view the overall expense summary.
Track balances across employees and managers.
Monitor recent transactions and access analytics insights for cash planning.

cashier-add-own-expense.title: Part 2: Add Your Own Expense
paragraphs: Go to My Expenses from the sidebar.
Click Add Expense and fill Category, Title, Location, Amount, and receipt if applicable.
Click Submit to record the expense in the system.

cashier-track-all-expenses.title: Part 3: View and Track All Expenses
paragraphs: Cashier can view expenses of all employees and managers.
Track submitted expenses, approved expenses, and pending items.

cashier-settlement-balance.title: Part 4: Settlement and Balance Tracking
paragraphs: Review approved expenses and compare approved amount vs actual expense.
Example: Approved INR 149,999 and actual INR 100,000 means balance INR 49,999.
Collect the remaining amount from employee via cash or transfer.
Update the system with actual expense, returned amount, and mark as Settled or Closed.
Always add notes for exceptions (late submission, partial return, receipt mismatch) for audit clarity.

cashier-analytics.title: Part 5: Analytics and Insights
paragraphs: Use analytics to track highest-spend categories, department-wise spending, and overall financial trends.

cashier-notifications.title: Part 6: Notifications
paragraphs: Monitor notifications for new expenses and manager or admin approvals.
Use these updates to stay current in real time.

cashier-settings.title: Part 7: Settings
paragraphs: Open Settings to manage available platform preferences and operational controls.

cashier-end-of-day-check.title: End-of-Day Check
paragraphs: Ensure all collected returns are recorded and matched against transfer history.
Review any pending settlement items and carry forward action notes for next day follow-up.

cashier-pwa-install.title: Install PesoWise as an App (PWA)
paragraphs: Use the install prompt or browser Add to Home Screen to open PesoWise like a native app.
Helpful for settlement work on mobile devices at counters or in the field.

engineer.dynamicApprovalUnder: If amount is less than or equal to INR {{limit}}, manager can approve directly.
engineer.dynamicApprovalOver: If amount is greater than INR {{limit}}, request is sent for admin approval.
engineer.summary: Add your own expenses, review employee requests, and approve within manager limits.

manager-getting-started.title: Step 1: Login to PesoWise
paragraphs: Open PesoWise and enter your login credentials.
After login, you will land on the dashboard.

manager-add-own-expense.title: Part 1: Adding Your Own Expense (Manager)
paragraphs: Go to My Expenses from the left sidebar.
Click Add Expense and fill Category, Title, Location, Amount, and upload receipt.
Click Submit. Your expense appears in My Expenses with status Pending, Approved, or Rejected.

manager-review-employee-expenses.title: Part 2: Reviewing Employee Expenses
paragraphs: Check Notifications on the dashboard for newly submitted expenses.
Go to Review Expenses from the sidebar to view employee requests.
Open View or Approve to review full details, amount, and receipt attachment.
Verify (approve) or reject with remarks when needed.
Use clear rejection comments so employees can correct and resubmit without delay.

manager-hierarchy-workflow.title: Part 2a: Hierarchy Workflow (Manager Tier)
paragraphs: When approval hierarchy is enabled, expenses may reach you after team leader and/or executive verification.
You provide manager-tier approval; high-value items may still escalate to admin per threshold.
Check approval tier on each expense to see which steps are already complete.

manager-batch-review.title: Part 2b: Batch Expense Review
paragraphs: Employees may submit multiple expenses in one batch when batch entry is enabled.
Open batch review to verify or reject grouped submissions together.
Review each line item; reject the batch with clear comments if any entry is non-compliant.

manager-approval-rules.title: Approval Rules
paragraphs: If amount is less than or equal to INR 50,000, manager can approve directly.
If amount is greater than INR 50,000, request is sent for admin approval.

manager-status-updates.title: Status Updates
paragraphs: After manager action, expense status updates immediately in the workflow.
Employees can track latest status in their dashboard.

manager-review-checklist.title: Manager Review Checklist
paragraphs: Check amount reasonability against trip purpose and category.
Confirm receipt quality (readable amount, date, vendor) before verification.
Escalate policy exceptions to admin instead of force-approving unclear claims.

manager-corrections.title: Expense Corrections
paragraphs: When enabled, managers may correct another user's expense details before approval.
Corrections mark the expense as edited; document why in comments for audit.

manager-pwa-install.title: Install PesoWise as an App (PWA)
paragraphs: Install PesoWise on your phone for quick access to review queues and notifications.
Use Add to Home Screen from your browser when the install banner appears.

employee.summary: Add, submit, and track your expenses from dashboard to final approval.

employee-getting-started.title: Step 1: Login to PesoWise
paragraphs: Open PesoWise and enter your login credentials.
Once logged in, you will land on the dashboard.

employee-employee-id-login.title: Step 1a: Login with Employee ID
paragraphs: On your organization subdomain, you may sign in with Employee ID and password instead of email.
Use the employee ID assigned by your admin; contact admin if you do not know your ID.
Keep your password private and change it if you suspect it was shared.

employee-my-expenses.title: Step 2: Go to My Expenses
paragraphs: From the left sidebar, click My Expenses.
This section shows all your submitted expenses.

employee-add-expense.title: Step 3: Add a New Expense
paragraphs: Click Add Expense to open the expense form.

employee-batch-entry.title: Step 3a: Batch Expense Entry
paragraphs: When batch entry is enabled, you can submit multiple expenses in one wizard flow.
Add each line with category, amount, and receipt as required.
Submit the batch once; all items move through approval together.

employee-fill-details.title: Step 4: Fill in Expense Details
paragraphs: Enter category (for example Airfare), title (for example Business Meeting Travel), location, and total amount.
Upload the receipt or supporting proof before submitting.
Make sure amount entered in the form matches the receipt total.
If your form shows extra fields after selecting a dropdown option, fill those conditional fields completely.

employee-submit-expense.title: Step 5: Submit Expense
paragraphs: After filling all required fields, click Submit.
Your expense is recorded in the system.

employee-hierarchy-flow.title: Step 5a: Multi-Tier Approval Path
paragraphs: Your expense may be reviewed first by your team leader and/or executive before reaching the manager.
Status stays submitted while intermediate reviewers verify; you will see updates in My Expenses and Notifications.
If rejected at any tier, read comments, correct details, and resubmit.

employee-track-status.title: Step 6: View Your Expenses
paragraphs: Return to My Expenses to see your submitted entries.
Track status updates as Pending, Approved, or Rejected.

employee-best-practices.title: Good Practices
paragraphs: Upload clear receipts and use descriptive titles so reviewers can process faster.
Check notifications regularly for remarks or action needed on rejected expenses.
Submit expenses early to avoid period-end approval delays.
If rejected, edit the same expense with corrected details and resubmit promptly.

employee-pwa-install.title: Install PesoWise as an App (PWA)
paragraphs: Add PesoWise to your home screen to submit expenses and check status without opening the browser each time.
Follow the install banner on your organization login page when it appears.

team_leader.summary: Verify team expenses, reject with clear comments, and forward compliant claims to the next tier.

tl-getting-started.title: Step 1: Login and Scope
paragraphs: Sign in to PesoWise with your team leader account for the correct organization.
Your queue shows expenses submitted by employees on your team.
You verify and may reject; final approval is done by manager or admin.

tl-review-queue.title: Step 2: Review Team Expenses
paragraphs: Open Review Expenses or Notifications for new submissions.
Check amount, category, receipt, and custom fields against team policy.
Verify to advance the expense to the next tier, or reject with specific correction notes.

tl-reject-guidance.title: Step 3: Rejecting Expenses
paragraphs: Reject when receipts are missing, amounts do not match, or policy is violated.
Write what the employee must fix so they can resubmit in one attempt.
Do not use reject for questions you can resolve by messaging offline; use comments when available.

tl-notifications.title: Step 4: Stay Current
paragraphs: Check notifications daily so team submissions do not age in queue.
Escalate repeated issues to your manager or admin.

tl-pwa-install.title: Install PesoWise as an App (PWA)
paragraphs: Install the app for faster access to your review queue on mobile.

executive.summary: Verify expenses after team leader review and route compliant claims toward manager approval.

exec-getting-started.title: Step 1: Login and Scope
paragraphs: Sign in with your executive account on the correct organization subdomain.
You see expenses that have passed earlier tiers assigned to you.
You verify and may reject; you cannot give final financial approval.

exec-review-queue.title: Step 2: Executive Review Queue
paragraphs: Open Review Expenses from the sidebar or use Notifications.
Confirm policy compliance, supporting documents, and amounts.
Verify to send toward manager tier, or reject with actionable comments.

exec-reject-guidance.title: Step 3: Rejecting Expenses
paragraphs: Reject incomplete or non-compliant submissions with clear instructions.
Employees edit and resubmit the same expense after corrections.
Coordinate with team leaders on recurring team-level issues.

exec-notifications.title: Step 4: Notifications
paragraphs: Monitor notifications for new items routed to your tier.
Clear your queue regularly to avoid blocking manager approval.

exec-pwa-install.title: Install PesoWise as an App (PWA)
paragraphs: Use Add to Home Screen for quick executive review on the go.
